title: Bachelor Party
novel:
Marshall's [[bachelor|bachelor]] party was supposed to be [[epic|epic]]. Barney had planned everything: [[cigars|cigar]], [[steaks|steak]], and a [[limousine|limousine]] to [[Atlantic City|Atlantic City]]. But when the limo [[arrived|arrive]], it was not a limo. It was a [[school bus|school bus]] painted black.

"I may have [[overspent|overspend]] on the cigars," Barney [[admitted|admit]].

Meanwhile, Lily's [[bachelorette|bachelorette]] party was not going much better. Robin had organized a [[tasteful|tasteful]] dinner at a nice restaurant, but Lily's [[grandmother|grandmother]] had other ideas. She [[ordered|order]] a [[stripper|stripper]] — who turned out to be the same guy who had been at Lily's [[bridal|bridal]] [[shower|shower]], her [[engagement|engagement]] party, and [[somehow|somehow]] her [[kindergarten|kindergarten]] [[graduation|graduation]].

"Is there an event in my life he hasn't been at?" Lily [[wondered|wonder]].

The bachelor party [[derailed|derail]] further when Marshall [[confessed|confess]] to Ted that he was [[terrified|terrify]] — not of marrying Lily, but of the [[ceremony|ceremony]] itself. "What if I [[trip|trip]] walking down the [[aisle|aisle]]? What if I [[forget|forget]] my [[vows|vow]]? What if my [[voice|voice]] [[cracks|crack]]?"

"Marshall," Ted said, putting his hand on his friend's shoulder, "you [[survived|survive]] Lily leaving for San Francisco. You [[survived|survive]] six months without her. A wedding ceremony is nothing."

Marshall took a deep breath. "You're right." Then Barney, who had disappeared for twenty minutes, returned wearing a [[gorilla|gorilla]] suit. "For the [[entertainment|entertainment]]!" he explained. "They were out of [[magicians|magician]]."

It was not the bachelor party anyone [[expected|expect]]. It was better.

bachelor.en: a man who is not married; especially one about to get married

cigar.en: a thick roll of tobacco leaves for smoking

steak.en: a thick flat piece of meat, usually beef

limousine.en: a large expensive car, often with a driver

arrive.en: to reach a place at the end of a journey

school bus.en: a large yellow vehicle that takes children to and from school

overspend.en: to spend more money than you intended or can afford

admit.en: to say that something is true, especially something you are not proud of

bachelorette.en: a party for a woman about to get married with her female friends

tasteful.en: showing good judgment in style or quality

grandmother.en: the mother of your mother or father

order.en: to ask for goods or services to be delivered

stripper.en: a performer who takes off their clothes to music

bridal.en: relating to a bride or a wedding

shower.cn: 送礼会（尤指婚礼送礼会）
shower.en: a party where gifts are given for a wedding or baby

somehow.en: in a way that is not known or certain

graduation.en: a ceremony where you receive a degree or diploma

wonder.en: to want to know something or to think about it

derail.en: to cause something to go wrong or off course

ceremony.en: a formal public event, especially a wedding or graduation

trip.en: to catch your foot on something and fall

aisle.en: a passage between rows, especially in a church for weddings

vow.en: a serious promise, especially one made at a wedding

voice.en: the sounds you make when you speak or sing

survive.en: to continue to live or exist after a difficult experience

gorilla.en: a very large powerful ape from Africa

magician.en: a performer who does magic tricks

expect.en: to think that something will happen or be a certain way
